name: Backend: Split main.go into smaller files

done_when: A Python script exists in scripts/ that can query security event logs from journalctl output. Supports filtering by event type, date range, IP, user. Has --help. Documented in docs/SECURITY_EVENTS.md with usage examples.

name: Scripts: Rewrite fetch-feedback.sh in Python
done_when: scripts/fetch-feedback.py exists and replaces fetch-feedback.sh. Uses sops/secrets.enc.yaml/.env for secrets (not .env.feedback). ralph.py updated to call the Python script. Old bash script removed.

name: Scripts: Add --auto-fetch-feedback-script CLI arg to ralph.py
done_when: ralph.py accepts --auto-fetch-feedback-script <path> argument. When provided, calls that script before each iteration. Replaces hardcoded fetch-feedback.sh path. specs/feedback-fetch.md updated to remove options B and C, document only option A.

name: Frontend: Split upload.astro into smaller files
done_when: upload.astro is under 2000 lines. Logic is extracted into utility .ts files or smaller components. All tests still pass. File size lint passes without warnings for the extracted files.

name: Bug: Night mode CTA text unreadable on home page
done_when: The 'Upload a Video' CTA button on index.astro uses var(--bg-color) instead of hardcoded white for text color, so it's readable in both light and dark mode.

name: Bug: Re-transcribe button shows no progress feedback
done_when: Re-transcription shows status text and progress bar while processing, similar to initial transcription. User can see progress and completion.

name: Bug: Bionic reading whitespace collapse in upload page current-subtitle
done_when: The .current-subtitle container in upload.css uses display:table (not flex) to prevent bionic reading word spacing collapse, matching the fix already applied in videos.astro.

name: Bug: Subtitle segments scroll too far ahead on videos page
done_when: Active subtitle segment is positioned at 1/3 down the container (showing more upcoming content and less past), or centered. Scroll position matches user expectation.

name: Bug: Feedback modal hides video and loses playback position
done_when: Opening feedback from the videos page does not close the video modal. Playback position is preserved when feedback is opened and closed.

done_when: Clicking 0.8x or 0.9x speed buttons on the videos page modal actually changes video.playbackRate. Speed UI updates correctly.
